title: Reading 실전 문제
introKo: 통과 80%. 지문을 읽고 푸는 25문항입니다. 고르기는 누르기만 하면 되고, 쓰기는 답만 쓰세요. 지문은 교재와 각 문항 위에 함께 있습니다.

questions.promptEn:
[01-06] 다음 글을 읽고, 물음에 답하시오. (교재 p.216)
I'm blind. I walk with a stick. One day, my homeroom teacher said, "There ①______ be a school event, Friendship Marathon. In this event, two people run ② as a team." Everyone talked about it. I also got interested. "But ③______ I run?" I was not sure. So I talked about ④im with my best friend, Junha. He said, "Don't worry! ⑤______"

During the marathon, I ran with Andy and guided him. It was hard, but we didn't stop ①run. (②) At last, we made it to the finish line! We didn't win the race. (③) But I knew that we did (d)best. (④) Finishing something was not easy for me. (⑤) I was very happy. Andy looked happy, too.

21 윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓒrun의 어법상 올바른 형태로 적절한 것은?
questions.explainKo: 정답: ② running. stop ~ing는 '~하는 것을 멈추다'이다. (교재 p.219 21)

22 윗글의 ①~⑤ 중 다음 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은? 「But this time I did it!」
questions.explainKo: 정답: ⑤ 「But this time I did it!」은 ‘끝내는 것이 쉽지 않았다’ 다음(⑤)에 와서 ‘이번에는 해냈다’로 이어진다. (교재 p.219 22)
